name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central sector scheme providing income support to landholding farmer families across all Indian states.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Landholding Ownership Records; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Register online at PM-KISAN portal or via nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
description: National health insurance scheme offering secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover across India.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empanelled hospitals nationwide.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Ration Card / BPL Card; Ayushman Card ID.
application_process: Verify eligibility on PM-JAY portal or generate Ayushman Card at empanelled hospital.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: National micro-finance credit loan scheme supporting small business entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakhs categorized under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun stages.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; PAN Card; Business Plan; Bank Statement; Identity Proof.
application_process: Apply online via UdyamiMitra portal or visit any commercial bank or RRB.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
description: Rural housing assistance scheme constructing pucca houses with sanitation facilities for homeless families across India.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹1.20 Lakhs in plain areas and ₹1.30 Lakhs in hilly states for house construction.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; SECC 2011 Data ID / Job Card; Bank Account; Swachh Bharat Toilet ID.
application_process: Selection conducted based on SECC 2011 data verified by local Gram Sabha.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
description: Urban housing mission providing credit-linked interest subsidy and construction assistance to urban poor.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans or upfront financial construction grant of ₹1.50 Lakhs.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; Land / House Property Documents; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via PMAY-U portal or through local Municipal Corporation CSC counter.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: End-to-end holistic support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hand tools across India.
benefits: Free skill training, toolkit incentive grant of ₹15,000, and collateral-free loan up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% interest.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Skill/Artisan ID Proof; Ration Card.
application_process: Register at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) via biometric authentication.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: High-interest government small savings scheme empowering parents to build higher education funds for girl children.
benefits: 8.2% annual interest compound yield with tax deductions under Section 80C.
required_documents: Birth Certificate of Girl Child; Parent Aadhaar Card; Address Proof; Passport Photos.
application_process: Open SSY account at any Post Office branch or authorized nationalized bank.

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA
description: National wage employment guarantee scheme ensuring minimum 100 days of unskilled manual work to rural households.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days wage employment per financial year with direct wage payment into bank accounts.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Job Card Application Form; Passport Photo; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply for Job Card at local Gram Panchayat office.

name: PM SVANidhi Scheme
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 with 7% annual interest subsidy on prompt repayment.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Certificate of Vending / ULB Recommendation Letter; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via PM SVANidhi portal or through local Municipal Corporation office.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring universal access to banking facilities with zero balance savings accounts.
benefits: Zero balance bank account, free RuPay Debit Card, built-in ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License; Passport Size Photograph.
application_process: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk to fill out PMJDY opening form.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed pension scheme targeted at unorganized sector workers ensuring fixed monthly pension upon retirement.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Savings Bank Account; Mobile Number.
application_process: Enroll through auto-debit facility at your bank or post office branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Comprehensive crop insurance protection scheme safeguarding farmers against crop failure due to non-preventable natural risks.
benefits: Financial assistance and yield-loss insurance claim settlement directly credited to bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Land Sowing Certificate; Land Revenue Receipt; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply through national crop insurance portal, bank branch, or CSC center.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Flagship skill certification scheme offering free industry-relevant skill training and placement support to youth.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free skill training, assessment certification, reward money, and job placement assistance.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Educational Qualification Certificates; Bank Account details; Passport Photo.
application_process: Enroll online on Skill India Digital portal or visit nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Maternity benefit program offering cash incentives for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Cash benefit of ₹5,000 paid in installments upon fulfilling health and immunization milestones.
required_documents: Mother Aadhaar Card; Husband Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; MCP Card (Mother Child Protection Card).
application_process: Apply at local Anganwadi Centre or register on PMMVY portal online.

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
description: Top class scholarship scheme providing educational support to OBC, EBC, and DNT meritorious students.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Scholarship of ₹75,000 per year for class 9-10 and ₹1,25,000 per year for class 11-12.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; Caste Certificate; Marksheet; School Admission Proof.
application_process: Apply online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or YASASVI portal.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
description: Central scholarship scheme awarding financial support to meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; Class 7 Marksheet; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) after passing state selection exam.

name: Stand Up India Scheme
description: Bank credit scheme facilitating loans for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield enterprises.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Caste/Category Certificate; Business Plan; Bank Statement; Address Proof.
application_process: Apply online via Stand Up India portal or through commercial bank branches.

name: PMEGP Credit Linked Subsidy
description: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme assisting self-employment venture setup in non-farm sectors.
benefits: Subsidy from 15% to 35% on project costs up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs for service units.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Project Report; Caste Certificate; EDP Training Certificate; Educational Proof.
application_process: Apply online on KVIC PMEGP portal.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme providing monthly security pension for unorganized sector workers.
benefits: Assured minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching the age of 60 years.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC code.
application_process: Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or self-register on PM-SYM portal.

name: Annadata Sukhibhava
description: State crop investment assistance scheme offering financial support to farmer families in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: ₹20,000 per year paid in three installments directly to beneficiary bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Pattadar Passbook or CCRC Card; Bank account passbook.
application_process: Register at local Rythu Seva Kendra or track status on official state portal using Aadhaar.

name: Jagananna Amma Vodi
description: State education assistance scheme giving financial aid to low-income mothers to support schooling of children in AP.
benefits: ₹15,000 per year directly credited to the bank account of the mother or guardian.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; White Ration Card; Bank account details; School ID proof.
application_process: Submit student and mother details through school headmaster or Village/Ward Secretariat.

name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena
description: Full tuition fee reimbursement for ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, B.Tech, and PG students from low-income families in AP.
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement credited quarterly to mother bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; Caste Certificate; College Admission Proof.
application_process: Apply online via JnanaBhumi AP portal through educational institution.

name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri
description: State cashless medical treatment insurance scheme providing health coverage to low-income families in AP.
benefits: 100% cashless medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empanelled hospitals.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; White Ration Card; Aarogyasri Health Card.
application_process: Present Health Card or White Ration Card at Aarogyasri desk in empanelled network hospitals.

name: NTR Bharosa Pension Scheme
description: Social security financial pension scheme for senior citizens, widows, and differently-abled individuals in AP.
benefits: Monthly financial pension ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹6,000 based on beneficiary pension category.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Age Proof / Widowhood Certificate / SADAREM Disability Certificate; White Ration Card.
application_process: Submit pension application at local Grama Secretariat or Ward Secretariat.

name: Pedalandariki Illu Housing Scheme
description: State housing scheme distributing free house site pattas and construction grants to homeless BPL families in AP.
benefits: Free house site title registration plus construction subsidy grant of ₹1.80 Lakhs.
required_documents: White Ration Card; Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; Bank Account Passbook.
application_process: Submit housing application at Grama Secretariat or Ward Secretariat counter.

name: YSR Vahana Mitra
description: Annual financial maintenance assistance scheme for self-employed auto, taxi, and maxicab driver-owners in AP.
benefits: ₹10,000 per year credited directly to driver bank account for vehicle insurance and repairs.
required_documents: Driving License; Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC); Aadhaar Card; White Ration Card.
application_process: Apply online via Navasakam portal or submit form at Grama/Ward Secretariat.

name: YSR Nethanna Nestham
description: Financial aid scheme for weaver families owning handloom equipment to modernize looms in AP.
benefits: ₹24,000 per year directly deposited into weaver bank account.
required_documents: Handloom registration certificate; Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; White Ration Card.
application_process: Apply through local Handloom Inspector or Grama/Ward Secretariat.

name: YSR Kalyanamasthu & Shaadi Tohfa
description: State financial marriage grant assisting poor families during marriage of daughters in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Financial assistance from ₹40,000 up to ₹1,20,000 credited to bride bank account.
required_documents: Marriage Certificate; 10th Class Marks Memo; Bride & Groom Aadhaar Cards; Caste Certificate.
application_process: Apply online within 60 days of marriage via Navasakam or Grama Secretariat portal.

name: YSR Cheyutha
description: Livelihood capital assistance scheme for SC, ST, BC, and Minority women to establish micro-business trades in AP.
benefits: ₹75,000 over four years (₹18,750 annually) directly transferred to beneficiary accounts.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Caste Certificate; Income Certificate; White Ration Card; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online through Village/Ward Secretariat office or Navasakam portal.

name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
description: Agriculture investment support scheme providing direct financial assistance to land-owning farmers in Telangana.
benefits: ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 per season for Kharif and Rabi) directly credited to bank accounts.
required_documents: Pattadar Passbook; Aadhaar Card; Bank Account details.
application_process: Register details with local Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO) or Pattadar database.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi & Shaadi Mubarak
description: Financial grant supporting families during marriage of daughters belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities in Telangana.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,00,116 directly credited to bride mother bank account upon marriage.
required_documents: Bride Aadhaar Card; Bride Mother Aadhaar Card; Marriage Invitation Card; Caste & Income Certificates.
application_process: Apply online via Telangana ePass portal prior to or within prescribed days of marriage.

name: Aasara Pensions Scheme
description: Social security pension for elderly, widows, weavers, toddy tappers, and disabled persons in Telangana.
benefits: Monthly pension from ₹2,016 up to ₹3,016 per beneficiary directly transferred to bank accounts.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; SADAREM Disability Certificate / Age Proof; Income Certificate; Ration Card.
application_process: Submit pension application at Meeseva center or local Gram Panchayat / Municipal office.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme Karnataka
description: Direct financial assistance scheme empowering female heads of low-income households in Karnataka.
ministry: Women and Child Development Dept KA
benefits: Monthly cash assistance of ₹2,000 transferred directly to bank account of female head of family.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Female Head; BPL / Antyodaya Ration Card; Husband Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via Seva Sindhu Portal or visit nearest Grama One / Karnataka One center.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
description: Unemployment stipend scheme providing monthly financial aid to educated unemployed graduates and diploma holders in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month for Degree graduates and ₹1,500 per month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Degree/Diploma Marks Card; Domicile Certificate; Bank Account Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via Seva Sindhu Portal uploading unemployment self-declaration.

name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
description: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme encouraging girl students in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 deposited directly into girl student bank account until degree completion.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; School Transfer Certificate (Classes 6-12 in Govt School); Bank Account Passbook; College ID.
application_process: Apply online via Pen Kalvi portal through college administration.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
description: Basic income entitlement scheme granting financial dignity to eligible women family heads in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Monthly financial rights grant of ₹1,000 directly credited to bank account of woman head of household.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Smart Ration Card; Electricity Bill; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Submit application during special camps organized at local ration shops / E-Sevai centers.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin
description: Financial independence and health nutrition scheme for underprivileged women in Maharashtra.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development MH
benefits: Monthly cash assistance of ₹1,500 directly transferred to beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra; Income Certificate / Yellow-Orange Ration Card; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via Nari Shakti Doot Mobile App or at local Setu Suvidha Kendra / Anganwadi.

name: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi
description: State financial support scheme providing supplementary income to landholder farmers in Maharashtra.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 (over and above PM-KISAN funds).
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; PM-KISAN Registration ID; Land 7/12 Extract; Bank Account Passbook.
application_process: Automatic benefit transfer for PM-KISAN verified farmers via MahaDBT portal.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme supporting health and education of girl children from birth to graduation in Uttar Pradesh.
ministry: Women and Child Development Dept UP
benefits: Financial grants totaling ₹25,000 paid in 6 phased milestones from birth to university admission.
required_documents: Girl Child Birth Certificate; Parent Aadhaar Card; Income Certificate; UP Domicile Certificate; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Apply online via Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala portal or through District Probation Office.

name: UP Abhyudaya Yojana
description: Free competitive examination coaching scheme for IAS, IPS, NEET, JEE, and NDA aspirants in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Free physical and virtual coaching classes, study material, and mentorship by IAS/IPS officers.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Educational Certificates; UP Domicile Proof; Income Certificate.
application_process: Apply online via Abhyudaya UP portal and clear state entrance eligibility test.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme aimed at improving status and wellbeing of girl students in West Bengal.
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) upon turning 18 if unmarried and studying.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Unmarried Declaration; School/College Enrolment Proof; Bank Passbook.
application_process: Submit application through institutional headmaster/principal on Kanyashree portal.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
description: Basic income support scheme for female heads of families in West Bengal.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development WB
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 for General category and ₹1,200 for SC/ST female household heads.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Swasthyasathi Card; Caste Certificate (if SC/ST); Bank Account Passbook.
application_process: Apply during Duare Sarkar outreach camps or submit form at local Block Development Office (BDO).

name: Ladli Behna Yojana MP
description: Financial self-reliance and healthcare support scheme for married women in Madhya Pradesh.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development MP
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,250 directly transferred to Samagra-linked bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Samagra ID; Domicile Certificate of MP; Bank Account with DBT active.
application_process: Apply via camp organized at Gram Panchayat or Ward Office uploading Samagra e-KYC.

ministry: Medical Health and Family Welfare Dept Raj
benefits: Cashless medical treatment cover up to ₹25 Lakhs per family per year in empanelled hospitals.
required_documents: Jan Aadhaar Card / Aadhaar Card; Ration Card; Bank Account Passbook.
application_process: Apply online on Chiranjeevi portal or present Jan Aadhaar Card at empanelled hospital help desk.

name: Karunya Health Insurance Scheme
description: Comprehensive health protection scheme for low-income families suffering from major illnesses in Kerala.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for treatment of critical illnesses.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Ration Card (Pink/Yellow BPL Card); Income Certificate; Medical Diagnosis Report.
application_process: Apply online via State Health Agency Kerala portal or submit form at District Medical Office.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
description: Comprehensive financial assistance scheme encouraging girl child education and empowerment in Bihar.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 paid in phases from birth until graduation completion.
required_documents: Girl Child Aadhaar Card; Birth Certificate; 12th/Degree Marksheet; Bank Passbook; Bihar Domicile.
application_process: Apply online on e-Kalyan Bihar portal submitting marksheet and Aadhaar details.

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
description: Financial assistance deposit scheme safeguarding newborn girl children and encouraging education in Delhi.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development Delhi
benefits: Term deposit grants up to ₹11,000 deposited at birth and school milestones, maturing at age 18.
required_documents: Girl Child Birth Certificate; Parent Aadhaar Card; Delhi Residence Proof (3 years); Income Proof.
application_process: Submit application at local District WCD Office or through Govt School headmaster.

application_process: Apply at Kiosk in Civil Hospital / District Hospital to issue MA Card.
